name_reason: Follows data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=tile events, descriptor reflects both data type (data table + ptr slot) and role. No Ghidra address residue; _ptr suffix correctly marks it as the BSS pointer slot. Accurately describes the verified use (base pointer of the per-chapter FDFIELD.DAT tile-event block consumed by fd2_handle_tile_event_interaction / fd2_check_tile_event_post_action).
purpose: Base pointer to the per-chapter tile-event data table: a 0x8A3-byte block loaded from FDFIELD.DAT (index chapter*3+1) holding scene id, chapter roster/spawn counts, and per-terrain-class field-event records (chest/gold/scripted-event triggers).
logic_summary: BSS uint32 pointer slot, zero-initialized. Populated two ways: (1) normal chapter init (fd2_load_chapter_battle_data) via fd2_load_dat_resource(FDFIELD.DAT, chapter*3+1); (2) load-game path (fd2_load_save_and_init_engine) via malloc(0x8A3) + memmove of the leading 0x8A3 bytes of the decrypted FD2.SAV buffer (the save embeds a snapshot of this same block). Both paths free the previous block before reassigning. Readers index the pointed-to block: [0]=scene_id, [1]=chapter roster slot count (-> party_member_count), [2]=field-character spawn-record count (-> portrait_cache_alloc_offset and FDFIELD 6-byte position-table base); walk-step post-action records at +0x33+(terrain_class-1)*2 (2B: consequence handler idx 0xFF=none, event-type gate); interaction event records at +0x53+terrain_class*3 (3B: type 0=ITEM/1=GOLD/other=scripted EVENT, uint16 value=item_id/gold/handler idx).
datatype: uint32 (byte* pointer slot; points at a 0x8A3-byte heap block)
element_semantics: Single pointer value (BSS, zero-init). Pointed-to block sub-regions: [0] scene_id; [1] roster slot count; [2] spawn-record count; +0x33 walk-step post-action 2B records by (terrain_class-1); +0x53 interaction event 3B records by terrain_class (type byte + uint16 value).
comment_original_issue: Original src comment was accurate but incomplete: it stated 'restored from FD2.SAV' as if that were the only/primary source, but the primary source on normal chapter init is FDFIELD.DAT[chapter*3+1] (the save path is only the load-game restore). It also omitted the pointed-to block's layout (scene_id/[1]/[2] and the +0x33 / +0x53 per-terrain-class event sub-tables).
notes: byte* pointer; pointed-to block size 0x8A3 confirmed by malloc(0x8A3)+memmove(...,0x8A3) in fd2_load_save_and_init_engine and the FDFIELD.DAT load in fd2_load_chapter_battle_data. Writers: fd2_load_chapter_battle_data @0x10907, fd2_load_save_and_init_engine @0x10193, fd2_chapter_transition_menu @0x2cb3c (all reassign the pointer after free). Many readers across battle/field/anim/spell systems. Name kept; comment augmented with source + block layout; empty Ghidra data plate created with concise layout.
